run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 core government portals were swept via WebSearch across all jurisdictions: Commonwealth (AusTender), NSW (buy.nsw / NSW eTendering), VIC (Buying for Victoria), QLD (QTenders / supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (SA Tenders and Contracts), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT (Tenders ACT). Verifiable open opportunities with real tender IDs and closing dates were captured for Commonwealth (AusTender ATMs incl. CSIRO, Defence, RASS), NSW (buy.nsw / TfNSW / icare), NSW & SA local government (Cootamundra-Gundagai, Copper Coast) and a VIC university (Monash). Tier 2 (water corporations, councils via VendorPanel, universities) was sampled and Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba/Business Network Discovery, EstimateOne, BHP, NBN Co, Ausgrid, Monash TenderLink) was checked. As on recent runs, NO publicly-advertised corporate RFx was visible without a supplier login, so Tier 3 is recorded at the portal level only in discovered_sources. MAJOR LIMITATION (unchanged from recent runs): the session egress proxy blocked ALL direct WebFetch page loads (EGRESS_BLOCKED for every host tried, including www.tenders.gov.au). Every tender below is therefore captured from web-search result titles/URLs/snippets only; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, contacts, documents and several exact dates could not be confirmed against the originating notice and remain pending a detail pass in a future run where direct fetching is available.
gaps: EGRESS BLOCK (organization network policy): WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for every external host tried, including www.tenders.gov.au. No tender detail page or document could be opened this run. Only WebSearch (routed through Anthropic, not the egress proxy) was usable, so all tenders are headline-level from search snippets and cannot be confirmed against the originating notice.

Because detail pages were unreachable, deliverables_summary, key_deliverables, scope_of_work, requirements, evaluation_criteria, documents, contacts and several exact publish/closing times are null/empty and marked pending detail.

Closing already past as at RUN_DATE 2026-08-30 (excluded as closed): Hobart City Council 'Domain Athletic Centre (DAC) Track Replacement' via Tenders Tasmania (closing ~20-Aug-2026); Central Coast / Tasmania stormwater and Deloraine netball court items surfaced but were not open.

NT QTOL (tendersonline.nt.gov.au): search snippets returned 'Nolans Project' package items (PM044 Product Bagging, PM002 Oxalic Acid and RE Sulphate Transfer Package). Nolans is Arafura Rare Earths (a private project); it is unclear and unverifiable whether these are genuinely advertised on the NT Government QTOL portal or a search-model conflation of the domain with unrelated content. Not recorded as tenders to avoid fabrication/misattribution; NT QTOL retained as a known source to re-check when direct fetch is available.

VIC: a 'Victoria 2026 Commonwealth Games' main-works construction tender surfaced from Development Victoria snippets; the Victorian 2026 Commonwealth Games were cancelled in 2023, so this is treated as stale/historical and NOT recorded.

Tier 3 corporate: SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery, EstimateOne and major-buyer portals (BHP, NBN Co, Ausgrid, Coles, Woolworths) are registration-gated or invitation-only; no publicly-advertised corporate RFx was visible without a supplier login. Recorded as portals only; no corporate tenders fabricated. Invitation-only management-consultancy RFPs remain out of scope.

CSIRO ATMs (CSIRORFT2026009 Banking Services; CSIROEOI2026001 Parkes Observatory cafe F&B) were returned under 'Current ATM View' URLs on AusTender so are treated as open, but publish/closing dates and full scope could not be verified without fetching the notice.
